releaseNotes: Added day-by-day practice history with Today and Last 7 Days summaries
Added study-time, dialogue, segment, vocabulary, phrase, recall and average-score daily records
Added separate Vocabulary recall lists for 1 Day, 1 Week, 2 Weeks and 4 Weeks
Added separate Phrase recall lists for 1 Day, 1 Week, 2 Weeks and 4 Weeks
Added Dialogue recall by complete dialogue with Start buttons from each due stage
Recall stages can be enabled or disabled individually in Settings
Completing one recall stage schedules the next enabled stage
Added daily reminder time, sound, browser notification permission and Test reminder controls
Added v9 practice-history and recall data to cloud sync and manual backup/restore
Recordings remain local to each device; cloud sync continues to sync learning progress only
All v8 Hide English/Hide Hindi, tap-to-reveal, voice discovery, search, recording and skip controls are retained
